[visual example omitted]

**代码示例：**

    opcode: 'testObloqSettings',
    blockType: BlockType.COMMAND,
    text: "初始化OBLOQ [SETTINGS]",
    arguments: {
        SETTINGS: {
            type: ArgumentType.OBLOQPARAMETER,
